title: NVIDIA to Invest $5 Billion in SSI, the Company Founded by Ilya Sutskever, to Deepen AI Computing Collaboration
excerpt: According to Bloomberg, NVIDIA is planning to invest $5 billion in Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), an artificial intelligence laboratory founded by Ilya Suts
content_html:
According to Bloomberg, NVIDIA is planning to invest $5 billion in Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), an artificial intelligence laboratory founded by Ilya Sutskever, co-founder of OpenAI and former chief scientist. The two parties have reached a long-term cooperation agreement, further strengthening their layout in the fields of AI computing power and model development.

The collaboration was disclosed on Monday. It is reported that this is NVIDIA's first investment after gaining a deep understanding of SSI's research progress, although the specific financial terms of the deal have not been disclosed. According to the agreement, SSI will adopt NVIDIA's flagship GPU hardware on a large scale, and its AI training computing power is expected to increase by an order of magnitude.

According to insiders, before this collaboration, SSI mainly relied on Google's TPU chips for model training. With the addition of NVIDIA GPU resources, the company will gain stronger computing power support for basic model training and the development of safe superintelligence.

SSI was founded by Ilya Sutskever in 2024, with the goal of developing "Safe Superintelligence." In April of last year, the company completed a $2 billion funding round, led by Greenoaks Capital, with Google's parent company Alphabet and NVIDIA participating in the investment. After the funding, the company's valuation reached $32 billion.

This investment also reflects NVIDIA's transition from a simple AI chip supplier to a core investor in the AI ecosystem. As the competition for large models enters a stage of comprehensive competition involving computing power, talent, and infrastructure, strategic partnerships between leading AI laboratories and chip companies are continuously deepening.

As an emerging laboratory that gathers top AI research talents, SSI's development direction has attracted widespread attention in the industry. NVIDIA's increased cooperation in this regard is seen as an important move in its bet on the next generation of artificial intelligence technology routes.

content_html_zh:
据彭博社报道，NVIDIA 计划向 Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI) 投资 50 亿美元，该实验室由 OpenAI 联合创始人、前首席科学家 Ilya Sutskever 创立。 双方达成长期合作协议，进一步加强在AI算力和模型开发领域的布局。

此次合作于周一披露。 据悉，这是NVIDIA在深入了解SSI的研究进展后进行的首笔投资，尽管交易的具体财务条款尚未披露。 根据协议，SSI将大规模采用NVIDIA旗舰GPU硬件，其AI训练算力有望提升一个数量级。

据业内人士透露，此次合作之前，SSI主要依靠谷歌的TPU芯片进行模型训练。 随着NVIDIA GPU资源的加入，公司将为基础模型训练和安全超级智能的发展获得更强大的算力支持。

SSI 由 Ilya Sutskever 于 2024 年创立，目标是开发“安全超级智能”。 去年4月，该公司完成了由Greenoaks Capital领投的20亿美元融资，谷歌母公司Alphabet和NVIDIA参与投资。 融资后，公司估值达到320亿美元。

此次投资也体现了英伟达从单纯的AI芯片供应商向AI生态系统核心投资者的转变。 随着大模型竞争进入算力、人才、基础设施综合竞争阶段，领先的AI实验室与芯片企业之间的战略合作关系不断深化。

作为聚集人工智能顶尖研究人才的新兴实验室，SSI的发展方向引起了业界的广泛关注。 NVIDIA在这方面加大合作，被视为其押注下一代人工智能技术路线的重要举措。
